(() => {
  const checks = {};
  document.body.innerHTML = '<section id=original><input type=radio checked name=choice><input type=text><textarea>initial</textarea><i>text<!--comment--></i></section>';
  const source = document.getElementById('original');
  source.expando = 'source-only';
  let events = 0;
  source.addEventListener('clone-probe', () => { events++; });
  const shallow = source.cloneNode();
  checks.shallowIdentity = shallow !== source && shallow.nodeType === 1 && shallow.tagName === 'SECTION';
  checks.shallowAttributes = shallow.id === source.id && shallow.childNodes.length === 0;
  checks.detached = !shallow.isConnected && shallow.ownerDocument === document && source.isConnected;
  checks.noExpando = shallow.expando === undefined;
  const copy = source.cloneNode(true);
  checks.deepIdentity = copy !== source && copy.firstChild !== source.firstChild;
  checks.deepMarkup = copy.innerHTML === source.innerHTML && copy.childNodes.length === source.childNodes.length;
  checks.radioTwice = copy.cloneNode(true).firstChild.checked === true;
  checks.textareaDefault = copy.querySelector('textarea').defaultValue === 'initial';
  copy.dispatchEvent(new Event('clone-probe'));
  source.dispatchEvent(new Event('clone-probe'));
  checks.noListeners = events === 1;
  copy.id = 'copy';
  copy.firstChild.name = 'copied-choice';
  checks.independentAttributes = source.id === 'original' && source.firstChild.name === 'choice';
  const input = source.querySelector('input');
  const textInput = source.querySelector('[type=text]');
  const textarea = source.querySelector('textarea');
  input.checked = false;
  input.indeterminate = true;
  textInput.value = 'input-current';
  textarea.value = 'textarea-current';
  const dirty = source.cloneNode(true);
  const dirtyInput = dirty.querySelector('[type=text]');
  const dirtyRadio = dirty.querySelector('[type=radio]');
  const dirtyTextarea = dirty.querySelector('textarea');
  checks.inputValue = dirtyInput.value === 'input-current' && dirtyInput.defaultValue === '';
  checks.checkedState = dirtyRadio.checked === false && dirtyRadio.defaultChecked === true;
  checks.indeterminateState = dirtyRadio.indeterminate === true;
  checks.textareaValue = dirtyTextarea.value === 'textarea-current' && dirtyTextarea.defaultValue === 'initial';
  dirtyInput.value = 'changed-copy';
  dirtyTextarea.value = 'changed-copy';
  checks.independentValues = textInput.value === 'input-current' && textarea.value === 'textarea-current';
  const text = document.createTextNode('alpha');
  const textCopy = text.cloneNode(true);
  textCopy.data = 'beta';
  checks.text = text !== textCopy && text.data === 'alpha' && textCopy.data === 'beta';
  const comment = document.createComment('comment-value');
  const commentCopy = comment.cloneNode();
  checks.comment = comment !== commentCopy && commentCopy.nodeType === 8 && commentCopy.data === 'comment-value';
  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
  fragment.appendChild(copy);
  const fragmentCopy = fragment.cloneNode(true);
  checks.fragment = fragmentCopy.nodeType === 11 && fragmentCopy.firstChild !== copy && fragmentCopy.firstChild.id === 'copy';
  const attr = document.createAttributeNS('urn:test', 'p:key');
  attr.value = 'attribute-value';
  const attrCopy = attr.cloneNode();
  checks.attribute = attr !== attrCopy && attrCopy.nodeType === 2 && attrCopy.name === 'p:key' && attrCopy.value === attr.value && attrCopy.ownerElement === null && attrCopy.ownerDocument === document;
  const shallowDocument = document.cloneNode();
  checks.shallowDocument = shallowDocument !== document && shallowDocument.nodeType === 9 && shallowDocument.childNodes.length === 0 && shallowDocument.ownerDocument === null && shallowDocument.contentType === 'text/html';
  const deepDocument = document.cloneNode(true);
  checks.deepDocument = deepDocument.documentElement !== document.documentElement && deepDocument.body.ownerDocument === deepDocument && deepDocument.body.innerHTML === document.body.innerHTML;
  const xml = document.implementation.createDocument('urn:test', 'p:Root', null);
  const xmlCopy = xml.cloneNode(true);
  checks.xml = xmlCopy.contentType === 'application/xml' && xmlCopy.documentElement.nodeName === 'p:Root' && xmlCopy.documentElement.ownerDocument === xmlCopy;
  const host = document.createElement('div');
  const shadow = host.attachShadow({mode:'open'});
  try { shadow.cloneNode(true); checks.shadowRejects = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.shadowRejects = error.name === 'NotSupportedError'; }
  let constructors = 0;
  class CloneProbe extends HTMLElement {
    constructor() { super(); constructors++; }
  }
  customElements.define('clone-probe-element', CloneProbe);
  const custom = document.createElement('clone-probe-element');
  custom.setAttribute('data-value', 'kept');
  const customCopy = custom.cloneNode(true);
  checks.custom = customCopy !== custom && customCopy instanceof CloneProbe && constructors === 2 && customCopy.getAttribute('data-value') === 'kept';
  const clean = document.createElement('textarea');
  clean.defaultValue = 'default';
  const cleanCopy = clean.cloneNode();
  checks.cleanShallowValue = cleanCopy.value === 'default' && cleanCopy.defaultValue === '';
  cleanCopy.setAttribute('title', 'unrelated');
  checks.unrelatedMutation = cleanCopy.value === 'default';
  try { cleanCopy.appendChild(cleanCopy); } catch (error) {}
  checks.failedMutation = cleanCopy.value === 'default';
  cleanCopy.defaultValue = 'new-default';
  checks.cleanDefaultChange = cleanCopy.value === 'new-default';
  cleanCopy.firstChild.data = 'new-text';
  checks.cleanTextChange = cleanCopy.value === 'new-text';
  const cleanDeep = clean.cloneNode(true);
  cleanDeep.firstChild.remove();
  checks.cleanRemoval = cleanDeep.value === '';
  const moved = clean.cloneNode(true);
  document.createElement('div').appendChild(moved.firstChild);
  checks.cleanMove = moved.value === '';
  dirtyTextarea.defaultValue = 'changed-default';
  checks.dirtyDefaultChange = dirtyTextarea.value === 'changed-copy';
  const select = document.createElement('select');
  select.innerHTML = '<option selected>one</option><option>two</option>';
  select.options[1].selected = true;
  const selectCopy = select.cloneNode(true);
  checks.selectionState = selectCopy.selectedIndex === 0 && selectCopy.options[0].defaultSelected && !select.options[1].cloneNode(true).selected;
  return checks;
})()
